```{r setup, include=FALSE}
############################################################################
##  R3 — FULL analysis + figures for the single Antisocial-like factor
##  (correlations + GLMs, both with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction,
##   plus the two publication figures). Replaces scripts 05 and 06.
##
##  Input (place in  data/ ):
##    Data_R3_Todo_missingcorrect.csv  (N = 48; ';' sep, decimal comma)
##    Data_R3_AFF.csv                  (n = 31; BZ + AI, affiliative only)
##
##  Output:
##    outputs/  corr_antisocial_behavior.csv, corr_antisocial_16PF.csv,
##              GLM_modelselection.csv, GLM_posthoc_BH.csv, analysis_log.txt
##    figures/  Figure1_GLM_effects.(pdf|png), Figure2_correlations.(pdf|png)
##
##  HOW TO RUN: open in RStudio and press "Source".
############################################################################

## ---- 0. PATHS + PACKAGES --------------------------------------------------
base_dir    <- "/Users/miquelllorente/Documents/R_files/Valcarcel_antisocial"
dir_data    <- file.path(base_dir, "data")
dir_out     <- file.path(base_dir, "outputs")
dir_fig     <- file.path(base_dir, "figures")
dir_scripts <- file.path(base_dir, "scripts")
for (d in c(base_dir, dir_data, dir_out, dir_fig, dir_scripts))
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)

pkgs <- c("MuMIn","car","dplyr","performance","jtools","emmeans","ppcor",
          "ggplot2","ggsignif","ggpubr")
for (p in pkgs) if (!require(p, character.only = TRUE)) { install.packages(p); library(p, character.only = TRUE) }

## ---- archive a copy of this script into scripts/ (robust) -----------------
get_script_path <- function() {
  ## 1) RStudio editor (works with the Source button if the file is saved)
  if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) &&
      rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
    p <- tryCatch(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path, error = function(e) "")
    if (nzchar(p)) return(normalizePath(p, mustWork = FALSE))
  }
  ## 2) source("file.R") sets 'ofile' in a parent frame
  for (i in seq_len(sys.nframe())) {
    of <- tryCatch(sys.frame(i)$ofile, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(of) && nzchar(of)) return(normalizePath(of, mustWork = FALSE))
  }
  ## 3) Rscript
  ca <- grep("^--file=", commandArgs(FALSE), value = TRUE)
  if (length(ca)) return(normalizePath(sub("^--file=", "", ca), mustWork = FALSE))
  ""
}
sp <- get_script_path()
if (nzchar(sp) && file.exists(sp)) {
  dest <- file.path(dir_scripts, basename(sp))
  if (normalizePath(sp) != normalizePath(dest, mustWork = FALSE)) {
    ok <- file.copy(sp, dest, overwrite = TRUE)
    message(if (ok) paste0("Script archived to: ", dest) else "WARNING: copy failed.")
  } else message("Script already lives in scripts/: ", dest)
} else {
  message("NOTE: could not auto-locate this script. Save it manually in:\n  ", dir_scripts,
          "\n(Tip: use RStudio's 'Source' button, not line-by-line Run, and save the file first.)")
}

## ---- 1. READ + RECODE -----------------------------------------------------
read_flora <- function(f) read.csv2(file.path(dir_data, f), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
                                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = TRUE)
Data  <- read_flora("Data_R3_Todo_missingcorrect.csv")   # N = 48
DataA <- read_flora("Data_R3_AFF.csv")                   # n = 31 (affiliative)

## EAE predictors are categorical; 999 = missing. Mother separation M3 = Unknown -> missing.
eae <- c("Origin","EarlyRearing","AgeArrival","PastExperiences","MotherSeparation","Abuse")
recode_eae <- function(d){
  for (v in eae) d[[v]][d[[v]] == "999"] <- NA
  d$MotherSeparation[d$MotherSeparation == "M3"] <- NA
  for (v in eae) d[[v]] <- factor(d[[v]])
  d
}
Data  <- recode_eae(Data);  DataA <- recode_eae(DataA)

sink(file.path(dir_out, "analysis_log.txt"), split = TRUE)
cat("R3 analysis + figures —", format(Sys.time()), "\n")
cat("N =", nrow(Data), " | affiliative n =", nrow(DataA), "\n\n")

## ==========================================================================
## 2. CORRELATIONS  (partial Spearman, controlling for Sex; BH within family)
## ==========================================================================
pcorr <- function(d, y, x = "Antisocial_z", z = "Sex"){
  ok <- complete.cases(d[, c(x, y, z)])
  r  <- ppcor::pcor.test(d[[x]][ok], d[[y]][ok], d[[z]][ok], method = "spearman")
  data.frame(pair = paste0("Antisocial x ", y), rho = round(r$estimate, 3),
             p = r$p.value, n = sum(ok))
}
famA <- rbind(pcorr(Data, "Aggression"), pcorr(DataA, "Affiliation"))
famA$p_BH <- p.adjust(famA$p, method = "BH")
famB <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Extraversion","Anxiety","Restraint","Dominance"),
                              function(v) pcorr(Data, v)))
famB$p_BH <- p.adjust(famB$p, method = "BH")
fmt <- function(df){ df$p <- round(df$p,4); df$p_BH <- round(df$p_BH,4)
                     df$sig <- ifelse(df$p_BH < .05, "*", "ns"); df }
cat("--- Antisocial x behavior (partial Spearman, control Sex, BH) ---\n"); print(fmt(famA), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n--- Antisocial x 16PF (partial Spearman, control Sex, BH) ---\n");    print(fmt(famB), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(fmt(famA), file.path(dir_out, "corr_antisocial_behavior.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(fmt(famB), file.path(dir_out, "corr_antisocial_16PF.csv"),     row.names = FALSE)

## ==========================================================================
## 3. GLM  —  Antisocial_z ~ a priori early adverse experiences
## ==========================================================================
cat("\n\n================ GLM: Antisocial-like score ~ EAE ================\n")
## A priori set (AgeArrival & PastExperiences excluded: redundant with Origin;
## PastExperiences perfectly confounded with Origin, Cramer's V = 1.00).
glm_vars <- c("Origin", "EarlyRearing", "MotherSeparation", "Abuse")
gd_full  <- Data[complete.cases(Data[, c("Antisocial_z", glm_vars)]), c("Antisocial_z", glm_vars)]
cat("GLM sample size (complete cases):", nrow(gd_full), "\n\n")

full <- glm(Antisocial_z ~ Origin + EarlyRearing + MotherSeparation + Abuse,
            data = gd_full, na.action = "na.fail")
cat("Collinearity (full model):\n"); print(check_collinearity(full))

best_set <- dredge(full, rank = "AICc", trace = FALSE)
cat("\nTop models (delta AICc <= 4):\n"); print(subset(best_set, delta <= 4))
cat("\nPredictor importance (sw):\n"); print(sw(best_set))
cat("\nModel-averaged estimates (95% cumulative weight):\n")
print(summary(model.avg(best_set, subset = cumsum(weight) <= .95)))

best <- get.models(best_set, 1)[[1]]
cat("\nBest model:\n"); print(summ(best))
write.csv(as.data.frame(subset(best_set, delta <= 4)),
          file.path(dir_out, "GLM_modelselection.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

best_terms <- attr(terms(best), "term.labels")
best_terms <- best_terms[best_terms %in% glm_vars]
posthoc <- data.frame()
for (v in best_terms){
  ct <- as.data.frame(pairs(emmeans(best, specs = v), adjust = "none"))
  ct$predictor <- v; posthoc <- rbind(posthoc, ct[, c("predictor","contrast","estimate","SE","p.value")])
}
if (nrow(posthoc) > 0){
  posthoc$p_BH <- p.adjust(posthoc$p.value, method = "BH")
  posthoc$p.value <- round(posthoc$p.value,4); posthoc$p_BH <- round(posthoc$p_BH,4)
  posthoc$sig <- ifelse(posthoc$p_BH < .05, "*", "ns")
  cat("\n--- Post-hoc pairwise contrasts (best model), BH-corrected ---\n"); print(posthoc, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(posthoc, file.path(dir_out, "GLM_posthoc_BH.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
sink()

## ==========================================================================
## 4. FIGURES  (ggplot2, APA)
## ==========================================================================
theme_apa <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13), legend.position = "none")
fill_cols <- c("#CBD6E2", "#E9C7C2")

## GLM sample with readable labels (E1/E2 and O1/O2 only remain after complete cases)
gd <- Data[complete.cases(Data[, c("Antisocial_z", glm_vars)]), ]
gd$EarlyRearing <- factor(gd$EarlyRearing, levels = c("E1","E2"), labels = c("Mother-reared","Hand-reared"))
gd$Origin       <- factor(gd$Origin,       levels = c("O1","O2"), labels = c("Wild-born","Captive-born"))

box_panel <- function(data, xvar, title, sig_annot){
  nlab <- data %>% count(.data[[xvar]]) %>% mutate(lab = paste0(.data[[xvar]], "\n(n = ", n, ")"))
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = Antisocial_z, fill = .data[[xvar]])) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.9, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1.7, alpha = 0.6, color = "#33506b", stroke = 0) +
    geom_signif(comparisons = list(levels(data[[xvar]])), annotations = sig_annot,
                textsize = 4, tip_length = 0.02, family = "Arial", vjust = -0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_cols) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(nlab$lab, nlab[[xvar]])) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Antisocial-like behavior (z)", title = title) + theme_apa
}
## p values below are the FDR-corrected pairwise contrasts (update if your run differs)
p1 <- box_panel(gd, "EarlyRearing", "Early Rearing", "p = .031")
p2 <- box_panel(gd, "Origin",       "Origin",        "p = .012")
fig2 <- ggarrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2, labels = c("A","B"), font.label = list(size = 14, family = "Arial"))
ggsave(file.path(dir_fig, "Figure2_GLM_effects.pdf"), fig1, width = 8, height = 4.2)
ggsave(file.path(dir_fig, "Figure2_GLM_effects.png"), fig1, width = 8, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)

## A white-filled label box is placed in an empty corner (top-left for
## positive slopes, top-right for negative), so the annotation never overlaps
## the data cloud. Labels are plain text (see caption for r_s = partial rho).
scatter <- function(yvar, ylab, annot, hpos = "left") {
  xr <- range(Data$Antisocial_z, na.rm = TRUE)
  yr <- range(Data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
  lab <- data.frame(x = if (hpos == "left") xr[1] else xr[2], y = yr[2], lab = annot)
  ggplot(Data, aes(x = Antisocial_z, y = .data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#33506b", fill = "#CBD6E2", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, color = "#33506b", stroke = 0) +
    geom_label(data = lab, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               hjust = if (hpos == "left") 0 else 1, vjust = 1,
               family = "Arial", size = 4, fill = "white",
               linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines")) +
    labs(x = "Antisocial-like behavior (z)", y = ylab) + theme_apa
}
pa <- scatter("Aggression", "Aggressive behavior (rate)", "rs = .64, p < .001", hpos = "left")
pb <- scatter("Restraint",  "Restraint (z)",              "rs = -.44, pFDR = .009", hpos = "right")
fig1 <- ggarrange(pa, pb, ncol = 2, labels = c("A","B"), font.label = list(size = 14, family = "Arial"))
ggsave(file.path(dir_fig, "Figure1_correlations.pdf"), fig2, width = 8, height = 4.2)
ggsave(file.path(dir_fig, "Figure1_correlations.png"), fig2, width = 8, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)

cat("\nDONE. Tables + log in outputs/ ; figures in figures/.\n")
```
